text:
Ava R: Hi finance — I paid our event photographer on my personal card because the corp card was declined at checkout. Charge is $1,020.00 (Stripe receipt). Vendor emailed a Stripe receipt (no VAT reg number, no supplier invoice). I need to submit for reimbursement and split costs 60% Marketing / 40% Events. What do you need?
Miles C: I approve the 60/40 split for budget. Attendees on the shoot: Ava R, Miles C, Zoe H. Business purpose: conference booth photography for marketing assets.
Samir R: Thanks Ava. Policy: expenses over $1,000 require a vendor invoice with tax registration number for VAT reclaim. A Stripe receipt often isn't sufficient. Can you attach the Stripe receipt and the vendor email here?
Ava R: Uploaded `stripe_receipt_20250610.png` to Concur and pasted vendor email thread. Photographer (BrightLens Media) says "We charge through Stripe and can provide an invoice PDF but it won't include VAT ID because they're a sole proprietor." They offered a signed invoice showing services and VAT amount but no registration number.
Finance Bot: Policy reminder: to reclaim VAT we need the vendor's tax reg number on an invoice. If the vendor can't provide VAT ID, finance can still reimburse but VAT will be non-reclaimable. For interim reimbursement provide: card posting screenshot, vendor email, and manager approval.
Samir R: Two options: 1) Ask vendor ops to escalate with BrightLens to request a tax reg # or confirmation that they're unregistered (we need that in writing). 2) If vendor confirms unregistered, finance will reimburse but classify VAT as non-reclaimable. Which do you prefer?
Ava R: Please escalate — we prefer reclaim if possible. Ill keep the Concur item flagged as "interim - awaiting vendor invoice".
Vendor Ops: Thanks Ava/Samir. We'll contact BrightLens's account owner and request a formal invoice with company registration or a signed statement that they're unregistered (include business address). We'll update this thread when we hear back.
AP Team Bot: Note: expedited reimbursements available for card-close timing with manager approval. Ava, to expedite mark `expedite` in Concur notes and CC ap@redwood.com. If vendor cannot provide VAT ID and you want interim funds, AP can process within 48 hours after manager sign-off.
Miles C: Marked expedite and CC'd AP.
Samir R: Once Concur has the receipt + vendor thread + manager approval, AP will queue interim reimbursement. If BrightLens later provides a VAT ID and compliant invoice, finance will reclaim and post an adjustment. Use GLs `MARK-CREATIVE-2026` (60%) and `EVENTS-OPS-2026` (40%) when submitting.
Ava R: Submitted in Concur with split and notes. Uploaded screenshots and vendor email. Flagged `expedite`. Thanks everyone.
Vendor Ops: Quick update  BrightLens replied: "We are registered, but our invoicing is handled by an EU contractor and they can issue a VAT invoice within 5 business days including VAT reg number." We'll monitor and post invoice here when received.
Samir R: Great. If invoice arrives within 7 days we'll process reclaim. If not, AP will complete interim reimbursement and we'll reconcile later.
Ava R: Appreciate it :pray: I'll close the Concur loop when invoice shows up."
